name: Bellevue
beschreibung: The Hotel Bellevue is situated in Neustift im Stubaital in Tyrol, offering contemporary, well-appointed hotel rooms. Its location is exceptionally convenient for scenic hiking during the summer and world-class skiing in winter. Guests can unwind in the relaxing wellness area featuring a sauna and steam bath. There is also the option to book half-board dining showcasing authentic regional cuisine. The famous Stubai Glacier is accessible year-round, offering snow sports even into the summer season. The hotel is ideal for couples and families, with convenient public transport links close by.
